extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose used for?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose is a high-pressure metallic product. Typical uses include north American HP cryogenic loading, US HP steam transfer and US HP power generation. See the [high-pressure metallic hoses](/c/metallic-high-pressure-hoses).

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose lists several standards and certificates. Listed: ISO 10380:2012; Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU Module H; ASME B31.3, Section VIII Div 1; NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 (sour-service compliant); EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports on request. Ask on your request for the certificates the project needs and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose come in?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose is listed with a nominal ID range of DN 6 (1/4") to DN 100 (4"). Minimum bend radius is 100 / 600 mm minimum (static / dynamic) with the OEM figures; confirm the size on your request.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose take?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose has working pressure to 380 bar; working pressure 380 bar (smallest bore, double braid configuration). Burst pressure 1520 bar. Safety factor 4:1 per ISO 10380. Working pressure 380 bar (smallest bore, double braid configuration). Burst pressure 1520 bar. Safety factor 4:1 per ISO 10380. Operating temperature -200°C to +650°C continuous. All assemblies hydrotested at 1.5× working pressure with witness-test certificate available. Pressure falls as bore and temperature rise, so give the full duty.

faqs.q: What is the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose made of?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose has core / wrap material Type 321 SS, braid Double Braid — Type 304 SS and end fitting material 316L SS standard. Construction type: high-Pressure Metallic — Stresstite HP annular (Hose Master).

faqs.q: Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose: why fully-compressed corrugation?
faqs.a: Fully-compressed corrugation reduces convolution amplitude to maximize pressure containment per unit hose length. This delivers HP capability that standard (uncompressed) corrugation cannot achieve. Trade-off: lower bend flexibility and higher torsional stiffness — best for static or slow-flexure installations.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose?
faqs.a: To order the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose, confirm (a) line working pressure (or for fire-protection: the host hose specification), (b) operating temperature range, (c) bore size and overall length, (d) end fitting style. (e) braid count where applicable, (f) any required certifications. Indus quotes ex-OEM with mill test reports and pressure-test certificates.

faqs.q: What bend radius and weight does the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose have?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose lists a minimum bend radius of 100 / 600 mm minimum and a weight of ~0.75 kg/m. Keep the bend radius above the minimum, and do not twist the hose in service.

faqs.q: Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose: what materials are used in construction?
faqs.a: Core / wrap: Type 321 SS. Braid: Double Braid of Type 304 SS. End fittings: 316L SS standard. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Where is the Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose typically used?
faqs.a: The Hose Master Stresstite HP Annular Hose has several listed uses. Listed uses: north American HP cryogenic loading; US HP steam transfer; US HP power generation; US HP frac iron specialty.
